narrative.overview:
FlexInsight is built for strength and resistance-training athletes checking composite readiness, next planned sessions, training load, PR history, and private on-device AI coaching between sets on Android phones. The visual system draws directly from calibrated IPF competition barbell plates and stamped gym iron: flat, matte surfaces anchored by crisp 1dp machined hairlines, tabular competition numerals, and color bands restricted to functional status.

Both Magnesium Chalk light (ChalkGround / ChalkSurface) and Cast Iron dark (IronGround / IronSurface) are first-class operating themes selectable via System, Light, or Dark preferences. Light mode stays crisp under bright gym skylights; dark mode reduces glare in dim garage or evening sessions. Generic glowing gradients, drop-shadow glass cards, decorative rainbow accents, and uppercase eyebrow kickers above headings are explicitly rejected across every surface.
keyCharacteristics: Dual first-class chalk-light and cast-iron-dark material grounds tuned to WCAG 2.1 AA contrast (>= 4.5:1 body text, >= 3:1 large display).
Flat tonal containers framed by 1dp machined hairline borders (ChalkHairline / IronHairline), zero drop shadows, and zero nested bordered cards.

Strictly semantic IPF plate accents: Cobalt for primary interactive controls and AI coaching surfaces; Emerald Green, Warm Amber, and Crimson reserved solely for recovery readiness, moderate fatigue/deload alerts, and strain/error states.
Three-voice bundled typography (Barlow Condensed for heavy lift numerals and screen titles, Schibsted Grotesk for UI copy, Chivo Mono with tnum for weights, timestamps, and set telemetry).

rules.name: The Plate Color Law
rules.body: Plate hues (Green, Amber, Crimson) carry strictly diagnostic recovery, fatigue, or error meaning (and standard competition barbell sleeve colors inside BarbellSleeveDiagram); never use semantic plate colors as decorative card accents, and never hardcode hex literals inside screen composables (the sole exception is the Glance FlexHomeWidget, which mirrors the exact Light/Dark ColorProvider pairs from Color.kt).

rules.name: The Contrast-Paired Container Rule
rules.body: Every light-mode status banner, pill, and icon container pairs dark ink (on*Container) on a high-lightness container (*ContainerLight) rather than raw white text on saturated amber or crimson, preserving >= 4.5:1 readability in bright light.

rules.name: The Tabular Lock Rule
rules.body: Every numeric telemetry value—lift weights, volume totals, sync timestamps, recovery percentages, and exercise indices—uses fontFeatureSettings = "tnum" via PlateNumeral* or MonoMetric* so columns never jitter as values update.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Screen headers and cards never stack small uppercase eyebrow kickers above titles. Headings carry their own weight via scale, bold contrast, and a 1dp bottom divider (TopAppBar hairline).

rules.name: The Single-Boundary Rule
rules.body: Cards frame content once with BorderStroke(1.dp, FlexTheme.colors.hairline) at tonalElevation = 0.dp. Sub-regions inside a PlateCard separate using HorizontalDivider(1.dp, FlexTheme.colors.hairline) or unbordered tonal fills (surfaceContainerLow), never nested bordered cards.

rules.name: The Scrim-Free Chrome Rule
rules.body: TopAppBar, LiveRestTimerStrip, and FlexBottomNavigation sit flush on the background/surface plane separated by a single 1.dp hairline divider instead of blurred glass or gradient fades.

dos: Do route every color through MaterialTheme.colorScheme or FlexTheme.colors (Color.kt) and verify contrast in both Light and Dark themes.
Do format every numeric telemetry string with PlateNumeral* (Barlow Condensed, tnum) or MonoMetric* (Chivo Mono, tnum).
Do enforce 48x48dp minimum touch targets on every clickable pill, chip, tab, icon button, and banner action.
Do separate subsections inside a PlateCard with 1.dp HorizontalDivider or unbordered tonal Box fills (surfaceContainerLow).
Do preserve navigationBarsPadding() and imePadding() on detail/full-screen destinations (Recovery, WorkoutDetail, AITrainer).
donts: Don't nest bordered Surface cards or bordered tiles inside a PlateCard or ExpandableExerciseCard.
Don't add drop shadows (tonalElevation > 0.dp, .shadow()), glass blur, or decorative gradient washes behind text or icons.
Don't add uppercase eyebrow kickers above section or screen headings.
Don't hardcode Color(0x...) inside screen or component composables (only Color.kt and Glance FlexHomeWidget.kt define day/night palette literals).
Don't use Unicode emojis or ad-hoc glyphs in place of Material Icons.Outlined / Icons.Filled vectors.
